# CollectBot — Business Operating System

> One Business OS: Finance • Sales • Marketing.

## Product Overview
CollectBot is a multi-tenant Business Operating System (B2B SaaS) designed for modern businesses, freelancers, agencies, and enterprises to automate payment collections, invoicing, and business growth operations.

## Core Capabilities
- **Finance Automation:**
  - Automated GST-compliant invoice generation (PDF receipts, recurring schedules).
  - Multi-channel invoice follow-up dispatch (automated WhatsApp and Email reminders).
  - Razorpay payment gateway integration with instant UPI QR & payment link checkouts.
  - Automatic invoice reconciliation upon payment capture.
  - Expense tracking and multi-tier approval workflows.
  - Accounting ledger exports (Tally XML, Tally CSV, QuickBooks CSV, Excel CSV).
- **Sales CRM:**
  - Lead lifecycle tracking, pipeline stage visualization, win-rate projections.
  - Deal follow-up scheduling (calls, meetings, demos) and task management.
- **Marketing Automation:**
  - Multi-channel campaign coordination (WhatsApp, Email, SMS).
  - Discount coupon management (fixed amount and percentage discounts).
  - Campaign conversion tracking.
- **Multi-Tenant Workspace Architecture:**
  - Single-identity multi-workplace authentication.
  - Role-based departmental workspaces: Owner, Finance, Sales, Marketing.
  - Platform-level Super Admin monitoring.
  - Self-service Client Payment Portal (/pay/[invoiceId]).
